desc:
🥷 Welcome to Break and Steal!

How to Play:
🏦 Build your base
👮 Rob the vault for new items and escape the guard
🪜 Break into other players bases through the roof and steal their items
💸 Put your items on display to earn money
📈 Items increase in value the longer you keep them
💰 Buy bigger loot bags to carry heavier items
🏢 Expand  & defend your crime base


🎮 Supports Desktop, Console, Mobile, and Tablet players
